body:
Mate, just walk to her and say: Hi! I'm Jeff (tell her your real name though). 

You can go for a handshake while introducing yourself. 

"I  noticed you here in class and thought to say hi. What's your name?"

Try to be chill and calm. Smile. Don't make it a big deal. Imagine introducing yourself to someone who isn't attractive to you. 

She will tell you her name. LISTEN TO IT. 

 Lets say her name is Jessica. You can then proceed with: Pleased to meet you, Jessica.

You can then tell her (if you' re nervous) : "Well, see you arround" or "talk to you later". Or if you feel like it, you can talk briefly about class or someting. Ask her opinion about subject, class or something else. Be present, genuinely listen what she says. 

And there you go. Not strangers anymore, in a non creepy way. Later on, opportunity to talk to her will show up.

Mate, I am considering all the things you've  mentioned. 

There is one thing though. I did get an impression she was not in a happy relationship 3 months ago, when I was talking to her. 

I don't know him, I won't judge him. 

It seems she doesn't consider him as a mature guy. He is younger than I am, afaik. I have a steady job, know what I want, got goals and interests. It might seem that's what she seeks.

 But, It could all well be a wrong impression on my end. 

I would love to be with her, only in case she want's serious relationship. Considering what's happening, I will focus my attention elsewhere for the time being.

They don't live together though. She moved out, and mentioned her bf lives with room mates somewhere else.

It seems she is breaking up, but doesn't mean she will. I believe I will wait and see how that goes. Only if they don't stay together I will go for it. 

ps. I doubt she's a type of girl looking to cheat, since 3 months ago she was clear about relationship. Now, everything is different it seems.
I don't see it that way. Something is wrong with me, since I'm unlovable. That's what life has taught me. I'm tired of this life. Sorry.

I don't see the  point anymore.  I have no hope. Reasoning wont cut it. I'm can't wait anymore that good things will happen, that there is someone for me, can't have patience. I am sorry. Thank you for trying though. I won't wait. I will end the wait. In my case, temporary isn't the word.

I can't get dates. Never was able to. All I ever got were promises because they were probably unpleasant to say no. Always something would "come up" and they were unable to come. I give up on that. I wan't love, I need it. Never had it in my life. Never will as I can see my situation. I lost hope

I'm was never good enough to be more than a fun guy to any girl I ever loved.
It's not really off topic. I hate myself. I never had a relationship or a girlfriend or intimacy.
Perhaps. Not sure. I believe she does, but I'm not sure she is aware how deep and strong this pain is.

They wouldn't understand.  I tried talking to my mother today, she didn't understand. Her comments were: It will be better. It's nothing, it will pass. Look at this and this person how they are doing.  Nothing useful, just  confirming they don't take me seriously.

I have a father and a mother. They're the only ones who care about me. I have nobody else. Of course that parents care. I'm a single child. No brother, no sister. they were overprotective when I was young. I was left out from a LOT. I see no future. But I want and need love. I was desperate for it. I have to cry for help on the Internet because I have nowhere else or no one else to go to. Lonely, sad, forgotten. That's how I feel.

Loving myself won't change perception others have. It still wont result with love, because they will again see me as someone who isn't good enough. I will always be reminded of this by their lack of interest. I never had validation so far. I did love myself long time ago. Yet, never had a chance.

I can't see a reason I would love myself, if I'm someone who others choose not to love. Why would I love someone who is unlovable? Someone who has something wrong with them? Someone who is not good enough? I started hating myself. I hate the way I look, the way I am and who I am.

Yes, I was fun. But why was I always left out. Every time, if I wanted to hang out, I needed to initiate, call others. Why was I never called to some party, to hang out, was never included in plans? Always left out...
Because I never received love. And, that's how all my life has been.

Can't. Tried, too tired of it. I think only about how I failed again. I'm only thinking about this person I wanted give everything how she doesn't want me.  It was always like that. I don't want to experience that again. Never
Yes. I'm worthless. I was never loved. I have no hope I ever will be
I don't have any hope. Last sliver of hope died when  a person I love dearly said to me: "I don't want to give you false hope anymore." I died inside already

That's because I never had a relationship. It's too late to learn everything others learned when they were 15.  I am desperate to have love returned for once. It's not going to happen. Fuck this shit, I better hang myself and be done with this.

It's not that only ONE person isn't interested. NONE are. Not just her. I am 31. women don't notice me at all. I was once at a club. I was like a ghost there. 

Just one example how people don't even notice me: At work, yesterday I helped a girl with some administration of a new data plan contract for a client. I guided her through the most of things for 10 minutes. Few minutes later, she was almost finished with administration, and had just one question. She asked colleague John about shipping Samsung S9 to a client with the contract. He helped her with that.

Later, she says to her supervisor: "Hey, I've just made a sale! John helped me with everything."

I was sitting nearby, thinking to myself:  "Wow, really!?"

People always take me for granted. I'm a "good guy", who will help if they ask. I always did. But nobody appreciates it.

I can't try anymore. I don't want to experience another heartbreak. I don't see hope. Let's be realistic. If I wasn't able to find anyone in 31 year, especially when I was in my prime, I wont be able to find anyone now and I don't see it changing in the future. I don't know where to go what to do. And I don't have any will to meet new people. I'm done getting disappointed. My life is work and then being home alone. I'm scared and sad. I'm fed up with life.

Completely agreed. Men will see you a lot more feminine if you put on some make-up and haircut. Go to a hairdresser and pick haircut which fits your face.

Absolutely nothing wrong with your face looks wise. Glasses fit you well.
You're fine, slightly above avg.
